svg.title: Kelvin — quant trading performance and risk observability
svg.desc: Four capability pillars. Performance: indexed equity curve, daily P and L, expectancy. Risk: Sharpe, Sortino, maximum drawdown, R-multiple, regime conditioning. Attribution: per-strategy status and a machine-decision log. Discipline: benches negative-expectancy strategies and refuses trades in violent regimes. A machine in supervised training. Figures are indexed demo units, equity indexed to 100 and daily P and L in percent, not account balances. Not financial advice.
